name: Ember Hedgehogs

passive.text: Horde stack: X tokens on the board (HP = 4×X). Single-target overflow continues through the shared pool and culls tokens. One activation for the whole stack (simultaneous). Thin them → Spike damage drops with X.

notes: Horde BP=1. Fragile 4×6 (24): Spike 2+X/4+X/7+X (full 8/10/13) then melts. Cannot crit. Lock 2026-09-24.
